name: 5dive-backup
description: The 5dive backup plugin (the `5dive backup` verb): a nightly encrypted copy of a 5dive server's agents, to your own storage or, on a server 5dive hosts, to 5dive's, under a key only the owner holds. Not part of the core CLI: add it with 5dive plugin add 5dive-ai/5dive-backup.

plugins.name: backup
plugins.description: Every night the server sends an encrypted, deduplicated copy of its agents (homes, memory, chats, settings) to storage the owner chooses (S3, B2, SFTP, any restic backend or a local path), or to 5dive's storage on a 5dive-hosted server. The key is made on the server and given only to the owner, as a recovery code; one command restores a fresh server from it.
